findings.host_parse: Confirmed violation: complete unrelated corpus_entries.jsonl and problems.jsonl rows were decoded before key/uid filtering. Source, statements, starter/reference code and embedded public examples were therefore parsed when present. This is not metadata-only access.
findings.stdout: All 17 scripts have one print site each. Preparation prints selected numeric ID, approved source hash, recovered-public count and selected independent-set metadata. Runners print selected ID/variant/language/pass totals. No direct unselected-row payload stdout site found.
findings.selected_artifacts: Preparation writes original source and packets only after selected key/uid retention. Runners persist selected candidate observations, mutation snapshots, verdict diagnostics and summaries. These artifacts can contain selected source/case material; they are not universally metadata-only. This audit did not reopen observation payloads.
findings.candidate_input: Runner execute receives selected source, interface and selected args/kwargs, or fixed synthetic controls. calls.json excludes expected values. Full unrelated rows are not passed to execute. Static scripts show no direct route from skipped rows to candidate inputs.
findings.hidden_files: load_hidden_tests is called only from selected packet independent_test_sets using selected Problem objects. Its helper reads the selected hidden_tests_path and applies existing corrections. No direct separate unrelated hidden-file load found. Embedded public tests were still decoded in broad index scans.
findings.exceptions: Broad scans use json.loads(line) and literal key/uid lookups; no explicit raise/assert/print interpolates the unrelated row. Standard JSONDecodeError text reports error/line/column rather than its stored doc, and default traceback does not dump frame locals. Missing key messages identify the literal key. This is a code-level assessment, not proof of historical runtime hooks. Selected source parsing/checker failures and synthetic assertion messages can include selected data. Current sandbox._run_in may raise SandboxUnavailable containing the last 600 bytes of captured child stderr; child code has selected inputs. Harness candidate output is redirected/captured, and selected errors/results may persist in observations.
findings.actual_model_context: Known retained conversation descriptions show selected source inspections and selected counts. No concrete protected payload emission is established by this bounded audit. Conversely, no exhaustive saved terminal transcript or OS tracing was inspected, so actual non-emission across all historical commands cannot be certified.
findings.ad_hoc_commands: Earlier ad hoc source inspections decoded rows before conditional selected printing. They were not all saved as standalone scripts. Their full stdout/stderr and exceptions are not exhaustively reconstructible from the owned script inventory. Do not broaden the no-direct-site finding into a claim covering every historical command.
findings.shared_verifier: The parent separately identified broad parsing in corpus_campaign.verify_source during claim/intake. Its full output flow and repair review belong to the parent; this supplement does not certify that path.
findings.claim_correction: The prior incident phrase that model-visible outputs and candidate inputs were selected should be read as the observed/intended selected script flow, not as an exhaustive proof that no protected payload ever reached model context. Clean end-to-end protected-source nonaccess and protected-generalization claims remain unavailable.
findings.historical_binding: Current helper bytes are recorded for static context only; this does not retroactively bind historical executable/module versions. Owned ingestion script bytes match the earlier incident hashes.

preservation: Existing incident, freezes, scripts and results untouched. No candidate executions, corpus reads, test reads, repository or ledger changes during this audit.
